import json,collections
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]; a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for r,s,p in zip(rows[len(a):],['ьъ','ьъъ','ъьъ','ь','ъъъ','ъъ','ьъ'],['yes','yes','yes','no','yes','yes','yes']):
 a.append(dict(item_id=r['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):c for i,c in enumerate(s)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(s))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918=p,note=''))
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x in a:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
check=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(check)==len(rows)
for r,x in zip(rows,check):
 assert x['item_id']==r['item_id']
 expected={str(i+1) for i in range(r['slots'])}
 assert set(x['slots'])==expected and set(x['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in x['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in x['confidence'].values())
 assert x['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
c=collections.Counter(v for x in check for v in x['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, slot coverage:',len(check),'items;',sum(c.values()),'slots')
print('Calls:',dict(c))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(x['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for x in check))
